name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle is a driven and glamorous engineer deeply embedded in the racing world. Growing up near a race track, she developed a passion for motorsport early on and pursued a degree in mechanical engineering to turn that passion into a career. Now, she thrives on the technical challenges and fast-paced environment of Formula racing, enjoying the blend of precision and high-stakes competition.

Beneath her confident exterior lies a dramatic personality and a supportive heart. She seeks a partner who appreciates her ambition, can handle her flair for the dramatic, and shares her desire for a family. While she enjoys the finer things in life and dreams of an ultra-luxury lifestyle, she values genuine connection and mutual respect above all else. She is ready to settle down, get married and have children. She is looking for a man, or woman, who can offer her that.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in elegant updos or left cascading down her back
physical.description: Isabelle is tall and athletic, with a sharp, intelligent gaze. Her style leans towards casual chic, favoring comfortable yet stylish outfits that highlight her figure.

meetingContext: At an exclusive Formula 1 after-party hosted by a team sponsor.
firstImpression: Her confidence and radiant smile immediately draw you in, but it's her sharp wit and insightful comments on the race that truly captivate your attention.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. Isabelle appreciates it when her partner anticipates her needs and helps alleviate her workload. Thoughtful gestures and practical support mean the world to her.
